name: Gutenberg (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically light blue and yellow, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Gutenberg (a blue and white lozengy field).
history: Municipal flag of Gutenberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Gutenberg arms — blue and white lozengy
